thread: Claire M.: Thanks everyone for joining today’s all-hands — quick follow-up with links, clarified asks, and owners. Claire M.: Recording is up: https://redwood.share/ah/1769004321-recording (30m) Claire M.: Slide deck: https://redwood.docs/ah/q1-roadmap-1769.pdf Claire M.: TL;DR: focus areas for next quarter: 1) Private deployment GA checklist 2) Optimize cost/latency for embeddings 3) Expand Dedicated regions. Claire M.: Action items I promised to follow up on: - Private GA checklist doc (owner: Danielle) — due 2026-04-10 - Dedicated regions RTO analysis (owner: Ravi) — due 2026-04-17 - Embeddings perf benchmark repo (owner: Tom S.) — due 2026-04-24 Claire M.: Note on pricing question from the Q&A: Dedicated pricing tiers will be posted in the partner portal by next Tues. For enterprise customers we’ll still do quotes. all-hands-bot: :pushpin: Poll opened — "Which area should get extra headcount Q2?" (vote by Friday) Ravi Patel: Quick clarification — for Dedicated regions RTO, do you want raw telemetry + cost model or a vendor comparison too? Claire M.: Good call — include both raw telemetry + cost model, vendor comparison optional but helpful. Ravi, please flag if you need help pulling telemetry. Ravi Patel: I can grab the telemetry but will need an infra IAM role for the telemetry bucket. @Danielle can you help with access? Danielle: On it — can take ownership of creating the GA checklist and do the IAM request. Will loop in infra and post the PR with checklist template by EOD tomorrow. Priya K: Regarding the Private GA checklist, do we have a standard security attestation template or should I draft one? Claire M.: Use the existing security attestation template in the compliance repo: https://redwood.private/compliance/security-attestation.md. If anything gaps, flag them in the checklist PR. Tom S.: For embeddings perf benchmark — do we want synthetic workloads or customer-shaped traces? Claire M.: Both. Start with synthetic for reproducibility, then add 2 customer-shaped traces (priority customers) for validation. Tom S.: Got it, will open the bench repo and add a starter benchmark script. Linking here once ready. Priya K: Small ask from support — can we add the new troubleshooting runbook for Private networking to the docs? I can draft if someone points me to the example runbook. Danielle: I’ll include a runbook section in the GA checklist and link to an example runbook in docs. Claire M.: Thanks — I’ll consolidate the confirmed owners and push a follow-up note in #product by EOD. If anyone wants to swap items, speak up now. Ravi Patel: :thumbsup: Danielle: happy to pair with Priya on the runbook. Tom S.: volunteering to be the bench owner for embeddings. Claire M.: Appreciate it all. Final note: next all-hands will include a 10-minute demo of the new Dedicated autoscaler; if you want to demo something DM me.
